name: agent-manager.supervision-observation-read
purpose: Read one bounded Agent Manager owner board and select retained unfinished effort obligations without inference or dispatch.

page_size.description: One bounded owner board page, from 1 through 8 rows. The smaller page keeps the compact projection within the 64 KiB output tier.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the previous owner board page.

assumptions: Agent Manager GetEffortBoard is the canonical bounded source for retained effort ownership, goal-home acceptance facts, and runtime observations.
A missing authorized_by field is not admission evidence in either direction; retained orchestrator/worker references and explicit goal-home obligations remain visible.
Goal-home contents describe work but do not prove native admission or retained ownership; only board-provided orchestrator/worker references qualify a row for supervision.
invariants: Exactly one bounded Agent Manager owner board call; no shell-out, second state, inference, launches, assessments or promotions.
Unknown, review-required, blocked, stale and unavailable runtime facts do not remove unfinished retained owner obligations from selection.
Withdrawn efforts are shown as retired and never selected; rows lacking native retained-owner evidence remain visible as admission/completion unknown.
Partial, stale, unavailable and paged coverage remain explicit; the output contains at most 8 rows and 8 evidence references.

Owner references are stably ordered with known unfinished or unknown states before known terminal states, then capped at 8; owner_refs_total and owner_refs_truncated preserve evidence of omitted references.

bindings.note: One canonical page of the existing AM effort board; selection is deterministic and read-only.

signals.summary: Selected compact owner rows, explicit eligibility reasons, page/freshness coverage, total/truncated owner-reference counts, and bounded detail references
